Gluten Free is an achievement earned by defeating the Trilliax encounter in the Nighthold instance, while having consumed a maximum of 20 Toxic Slices of cake, on Normal difficulty or higher. Throughout the fight, Trilliax will spawn Toxic Slices of cake around the room of the encounter. Normally, these should be picked up to prevent raid-wide damage. For the achievement, however, you must ensure that, by the time Trilliax is defeated, the raid as a whole has consumed no more than 20 slices. Note that the achievement is party-wide, meaning that no more than 20 slices must be consumed by the entire raid, as opposed to each individual player.

Gnarlpine Corruption is an Alliance only quest in Teldrassil, the night elf starting zone. In this quest, players are sent by Gaerolas Talvethren to Athridas Bearmantle with a desperate report regarding the furbolgs of Starbreeze Village.

Gnarlpine Hold lies in the far southwest corner of Teldrassil. It was formally home to the Gnarlpine furbolgs. Recently, corruption has taken over the area and many demons are now present. A steady stream of demons flow out of the area to the north where Tarindrella and Teldrassil ancients meet for battle. During the Burning of Teldrassil, the conflagration spread to Gnarlpine Hold.
This is the first class quest you will undertake as a mage. It's purpose is to introduce you to your class trainer.

The Gnarlpine tribe was a corrupted furbolg tribe that dwelled atop the great world tree of Teldrassil. Though originally peaceful, the insidious effects of Fel Moss caused the Gnarlpines to go berserk and attack their former allies, the night elves. Apart from living in Gnarlpine Hold and their other traditional villages in the south and west of Teldrassil, the Gnarlpines also invaded Ban'ethil Barrow Den and Starbreeze Village, driving out or slaying the local inhabitants. The most dangerous of these corrupted feral beasts included Ferocitas the Dream Eater, Ursal the Mauler, and Uruson. They were led by Ursal and Ferocitas.
